scripts.build: npm run build -w @aqlamna/core && npm run build -w @aqlamna/runtime
scripts.build:site: npm run build:site -w @aqlamna/editor && node scripts/build-site.mjs && node scripts/build-docs.mjs
scripts.test:site: npm run build:site && playwright test --config site/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run check:artifacts && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:colors && npm run lint:docs-arabic && npm run check:doc-examples && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:site && npm run test:visual
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=aqlamna && npm run purge:zone
